source_en: Good work. If you need any more info, refer to the guidebook.
The job is straightforward. They have the symptoms, you make the call...
Quarantine allows us to cure their symptoms before they get too severe, effectively reversing their mutations.
Killing should only be a last resort. When someone is gone, they're {{gone for good}}.
As much as I dislike the people in this town, we need each other in times like these.
